name: KÖNIGRUFEN LUNGAU TAROCK
description: Königrufen Lungau Tarock is a streamlined version of Austrian Tarock played in the Salzburger Lungau region. It features regular tournaments and simplified rules compared to traditional Königrufen. The reduced choice of contracts and simplified card counting lead to a sharper game where valuable cards are more important relative to empty cards.
